notes.title: An Update for Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition Has Rolled Out for PC
notes.notes:
An update for [i]Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition[/i] is now in effect for Windows PC. For full notes on what's been changed or updated, see below: 

[b][i]Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition[/i] Update Notes- 6/23/17[/b]

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*]Added a new graphic setting for motion blur that can be adjusted based on individual preferences

[*]Updated PS4 Trophy pack, save data, and startup images

[*]Changed water to resemble it’s appearance in original Bulletstorm release
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed voiceover-sync issues for Duke Nukem

[*]Fixed an issue in which the Penetrator's firing and reload behavior could be slowed after extended use with unlimited ammo in Overkill mode

[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the Penetrator's projectiles to not stick into some objects

[*]Minor text fixes
[/list]
